description: Subtracting 1 inverts n ↦ n+1 on positive naturals, and division by 2 inverts n ↦ 2n on even naturals.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.ComparingSizes.positive_even_inverse_laws :
  (∀ (n : ℕ), n + 1 - 1 = n) ∧
    (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 < k → k - 1 + 1 = k) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ), 2 * n / 2 = n) ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ), Even k → 2 * (k / 2) = k
